configurations.name: website
runtimeArgs: import os, functools, http.server; port = int(os.environ.get('PORT', '8642')); H = functools.partial(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, directory='apps/website'); http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer.allow_reuse_address = True; http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', port), H).serve_forever()
